final: WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS customer_count FROM Employee AS e JOIN Customer AS c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), city_averages AS (SELECT City, AVG(customer_count) AS city_average FROM rep_counts GROUP BY City), above_average AS (SELECT r.City, r.customer_count, a.city_average FROM rep_counts AS r JOIN city_averages AS a ON r.City = a.City WHERE r.customer_count > a.city_average) SELECT City, SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers, AVG(customer_count - city_average) AS average_above_city_average, AVG(1.0 * customer_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer)) AS average_rep_share_of_overall_customers FROM above_average GROUP BY City
